## Known biases

The Docker images are linux/amd64 only: on Apple Silicon they run under emulation, which may be slow. The pre-compiled executables and Docker images are under the Deltares Freeware licence (no distribution, no modification) while the source is GPL-3.0. The documented curve-number fault is described only in release notes, not in the Zenodo record.
